correctness.rationale: The full proof reconstructs the free-pair operations and nonerasing word projection. Idempotence implies length-one images for all letters that appear, then letter-by-letter equality forces them fixed. The reverse retraction construction is immediate from freeness. Exact length counts use all \(2^{j-1}\) control words, finite-max asymptotics are termwise, and strict concavity plus the Lambert W identity gives the rank scaling. CHECKER.py exhaustively tests direct composition and support histograms in seven small cases, without treating finite examples as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of idempotent images in the endomorphism monoid of a free two-operation algebra, motivated by the 2026 determinability result. Exact counts under the intrinsic word grading produce a genuinely different exponential-base optimization from ordinary free semigroups, including a rank-three support coexistence with weights 3:2 and an optimal rank asymptotic \(n/W(2en)\). It is not merely one arbitrary finite slice or a restatement of the known constant-idempotent case.
